title: Indrajeet
desc: Indrajeet, a retired police officer, sets out to take revenge on his ex-lover's brother and friends for murdering his adopted daughter and son-in-law.

title: Alludu Adhurs
desc: A young man named Sreenu swears off women following a failed relationship. However, he falls in love with a gangster's daughter and is even forced to compete with another man for her hand in marriage.

title: Barood
desc: Jai, an honest police officer, falls in love with Neha, Mr Singhal's daughter. However, he suspects Mr Singhal to be a criminal and tries to catch him red-handed.

title: Parivaar
desc: When a young girl is thrown out of her home by her evil relatives, she finds shelter with a poor street performer and his two children, a dog and a monkey.

title: Toofan
desc: Separated at birth, the paths of Shyam, a lousy magician unwittingly roped into a crime, and Toofan, a defender of the people, cross again years later as they reunite to avenge their father.

title: Phool Bane Angaray
desc: After her husband, Ranjit, a police officer, is killed by the corrupt and powerful Bishamber, Namrata pledges to avenge his death and bring him justice.
